test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct in the context of Swachh Bharat Abhiyan?

options.text: North-Eastern states are not involved in the campaign.
It was launched to achieve the goal of universal sanitation.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It was launched to achieve the goal of universal sanitation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** was launched to achieve the goal of universal sanitation.
 
• The campaign was officially launched by the Government of India on **October 2, 2014**.
 
• It aims to eliminate open defecation and improve solid waste management across the country.
 
• The initiative covers both urban and rural areas, involving all states and Union Territories, including the North-Eastern states.
 
• Swachh Bharat Abhiyan is a significant step towards promoting cleanliness, hygiene, and public health in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The campaign was launched on the birth anniversary of **Mahatma Gandhi**, who emphasized cleanliness and sanitation as an integral part of his philosophy.
 
• It is one of the largest cleanliness drives ever organized, with millions of government employees, students, and volunteers participating.
 
• The mission has led to the construction of millions of toilets in rural and urban areas, significantly reducing open defecation.
 
• Swachh Bharat Abhiyan also promotes behavioral change through awareness campaigns and community engagement.
